title: Dense QQ structural generated FFI
objective: Add generated FmpqMatrix structural resource operations for selection, block assignment, stacking, augmentation, and nonzero queries without public Matrix routing

oracles: FLINT fmpq_mat semantics and direct entry-level differential checks

handoff.summary: Adds generated FmpqMatrix structural resource operations for contiguous submatrices, ordered duplicate-preserving row and column selection through checked read-only UInt64Buffer slices, transactional block mutation, vertical stacking, horizontal augmentation, and native nonzero counts. Every owned result is exact-shaped and callee-owned, mutated resources refresh external-memory accounting, dimension sums are overflow-checked, and invalid bounds or aliases fail before mutation. Dynamic differential tests cover skew rational entries, ordering, duplicates, failures, and all zero-dimensional orientations; the lifecycle harness exercises 200 dynamic and 500 ASan/UBSan rounds.
risks: FmpqMatrix resources remain wasm=False, so portable public code must retain its existing tested capability fallback until opaque-resource WebAssembly lowering is implemented.

Row and column selection are separate one-buffer operations so each is directly compatible with the narrow resource-plus-UInt64Buffer compiler aggregate. Selecting both arbitrary row and column sets composes two owned resources; a measured need could justify a single combined-index declaration later without changing public semantics.

The shared base contains several integrated task contracts still marked active or review, so pnpm parallel:check cannot identify exactly one live task in this worktree; all task-specific, strict, portable, sanitizer, and architecture validation nevertheless passes.
next_steps: Route public dense QQ matrix selection, set_block, stack, augment, and nonzero operations through these generated resources and delete their packed whole-matrix materializations.
Differentially benchmark the public resource routes against SageMath and the retained legacy oracle after matrix.py integration.
Prove the same generated resource declarations under the future WebAssembly resource lowering.
